segments.en: Read replicas, replication, eventual consistency, failover
segments.zh: 唯讀副本、複製、最終一致性、故障轉移

segments.en: “I just bought a ticket. Why isn't it in My tickets?”
segments.zh: 「我剛買了一張票。為什麼『我的票券』裡沒有？」

segments.en: EncoreTo take load off the main database, Ana adds two read replicas: copies that receive every change a moment later. Pages get faster. Then fans start reporting tickets that vanish and reappear, and one night the main database dies.
segments.zh: Encore為了減輕主資料庫的負擔，Ana 加了兩個唯讀副本（read replica）：會在片刻之後收到每一筆變更的資料庫副本。頁面變快了。接著歌迷開始回報票券忽隱忽現，然後某天晚上，主資料庫掛了。

segments.en: lab · break it, then fix it
segments.zh: 實驗室 · 先弄壞，再修好
一個主資料庫，兩個副本

segments.en: All writes go to the primary. It streams each change to the replicas, which apply it after a delay: the replication lag. A fan buys a ticket every 0.5 s and checks “My tickets” 0.3 s later. Simulated numbers.
segments.zh: 所有寫入都送到主資料庫（primary）。它把每筆變更串流給副本，副本在一段延遲後套用：這就是複製延遲（replication lag）。每 0.5 秒有一位歌迷買票，並在 0.3 秒後查看「我的票券」。數字是模擬的。

segments.en: Replicas are always a little behind. If writes stop, they catch up and agree with the primary eventually. Until then, a read can return old data. That's fine for a concert list, not for “did my purchase go through?”.
segments.zh: 副本總是落後一點點。如果寫入停止，它們會追上，最終和主資料庫一致。在那之前，讀取可能拿到舊資料。演唱會清單沒關係，「我的購買成功了嗎？」就不行。

segments.en: When the primary dies, promote a replica to be the new primary. Done by a person, it takes minutes and writes fail meanwhile. Done automatically, it takes seconds, but any writes the replica hadn't received yet are gone.
segments.zh: 主資料庫掛掉時，把一個副本升級成新的主資料庫。由人來做要花好幾分鐘，期間寫入全部失敗。自動做只要幾秒，但副本還沒收到的寫入就會遺失。

segments.en: With async replication the primary confirms a write right away and sends it to the replicas later: fast, but if the primary dies, its last moments of writes die with it. With sync replication the primary waits until a replica has the write: every write is slower, but a failover loses nothing.
segments.zh: 非同步（async）複製時，主資料庫會立刻確認寫入，之後才送給副本：很快，但如果主資料庫掛了，它最後那段時間的寫入也跟著消失。同步（sync）複製時，主資料庫會等到某個副本拿到寫入才確認：每次寫入都比較慢，但故障轉移時什麼都不會遺失。

重點整理 · 帶走這些

segments.en: The whole page on one screen
The primary streams every change to replicas. Gives you spare copies for failover, and extra servers for reads.
segments.zh: 主資料庫把每筆變更串流給副本。你因此有了能接手的備用副本，以及能分擔讀取的額外伺服器。

segments.en: Reads from replicas take load off the primary but may be stale. Send “read your own write” queries to the primary.
segments.zh: 從副本讀取能減輕主資料庫的負擔，但可能是過期的。「讀取自己剛寫入的資料」要送到主資料庫。

segments.en: Promote a replica when the primary dies. Automatic is fast. Async replication can lose the last writes; sync can't.
segments.zh: 主資料庫掛掉時升級一個副本。自動的很快。非同步複製可能遺失最後的寫入；同步不會。

segments.en: Replicas buy read capacity and survival at the cost of consistency. Async: fast writes, stale reads, a small chance of losing recent writes. Sync: slower writes and no loss. Many teams use one sync replica (no loss) plus async ones for reads.
segments.zh: 副本用一致性換來讀取容量和存活能力。非同步：寫入快、會讀到過期資料、有小機率遺失最近的寫入。同步：寫入較慢、不會遺失。很多團隊會用一個同步副本（不遺失）加上幾個負責讀取的非同步副本。

segments.en: 'Press Play with 0.1 s of lag and reads from a replica.'
segments.zh: '在延遲 0.1 秒、從副本讀取的設定下按播放。'

segments.en: 'The replicas are only 0.1 s behind, so the purchase is always there 0.3 s later.'
segments.zh: '副本只落後 0.1 秒，所以 0.3 秒後去看時，購買紀錄一定已經在了。'

segments.en: 'Now “My tickets” is read from a replica that hasn\'t received the purchase yet. The ticket seems to be missing.'
segments.zh: '現在「我的票券」是從還沒收到這筆購買的副本讀取的。票好像不見了。'
'把「我的票券」切換成主資料庫（讀取自己的寫入）。'

segments.en: 'Right after buying, read from the primary, which always has it. Other pages can keep using replicas.'
segments.zh: '剛買完就從主資料庫讀取，它一定有這筆資料。其他頁面可以繼續用副本。'
'在手動故障轉移的設定下，讓主資料庫掛掉。'

segments.en: 'Every purchase fails until someone notices and promotes a replica: 12 s here, often 20 minutes or more at 3 a.m.'
segments.zh: '在有人發現並升級副本之前，每一筆購買都會失敗：這裡是 12 秒，凌晨 3 點常常是 20 分鐘以上。'

segments.en: 'Switch to Automatic failover (keep 2 s lag, Async) and kill the new primary.'
segments.zh: '切換到自動故障轉移（維持 2 秒延遲、非同步），讓新的主資料庫掛掉。'

segments.en: 'A replica takes over in 3 s. But the purchases from the last 2 s never reached it: they\'re lost.'
segments.zh: '副本在 3 秒內接手。但最後 2 秒的購買從來沒有送到它那裡：它們遺失了。'

segments.en: 'Switch replication to Sync and kill the primary once more.'
segments.zh: '把複製方式切換成同步，再讓主資料庫掛掉一次。'

segments.en: 'Each write now waits for a replica, so it\'s slower. But this failover loses nothing.'
segments.zh: '現在每次寫入都要等副本，所以比較慢。但這次故障轉移什麼都沒有遺失。'

segments.en: `✕ The primary is down. Purchases fail. ${S.auto ? `Automatic failover in ${Math.max(0, Math.ceil((AUTO - (S.t - S.downAt)) / 1000))} s.` : `Waiting for a person to promote a replica (${Math.max(0, Math.ceil((MANUAL - (S.t - S.downAt)) / 1000))} s).`}`
segments.zh: `✕ 主資料庫掛了。購買全部失敗。${S.auto ? `${Math.max(0, Math.ceil((AUTO - (S.t - S.downAt)) / 1000))} 秒後自動故障轉移。` : `等待有人升級副本（${Math.max(0, Math.ceil((MANUAL - (S.t - S.downAt)) / 1000))} 秒）。`}`

segments.en: `✕ ${Math.round(m.stale * 100)}% of fans don't see the ticket they just bought: the replica is ${S.lag / 1000} s behind, and they looked after 0.3 s.`
segments.zh: `✕ ${Math.round(m.stale * 100)}% 的歌迷看不到自己剛買的票：副本落後 ${S.lag / 1000} 秒，而他們在 0.3 秒後就去看了。`

segments.en: `✓ Running. Last failover took ${(f.took / 1000).toFixed(0)} s and lost ${f.lost} purchase${f.lost === 1 ? '' : 's'}${f.lost ? ' (charged, but not in the database)' : ''}.`
segments.zh: `✓ 運作中。上一次故障轉移花了 ${(f.took / 1000).toFixed(0)} 秒，遺失了 ${f.lost} 筆購買${f.lost ? '（已扣款，但不在資料庫裡）' : ''}。`

segments.en: '✓ Healthy: every fan sees their purchase.'
segments.zh: '✓ 健康：每位歌迷都看得到自己的購買。'
'# 主資料庫上的 postgresql.conf'

segments.en: '// app: writes to the primary, most reads to a replica'
segments.zh: '// App：寫入送主資料庫，大部分讀取送副本'

segments.en: 'const primary = pool("db-1"), replica = pool("db-2");'
'const concerts = await replica.query("SELECT * FROM concerts");'
'// read your own writes: right after buying, ask the primary'
segments.zh: '// 讀取自己的寫入：剛買完就問主資料庫'

segments.en: 'const mine = await primary.query("SELECT … WHERE fan = $1", [fan]);'
'# failover: a tool watches the primary and promotes a replica'
segments.zh: '# 故障轉移：由工具監看主資料庫並升級副本'

segments.en: '# (Patroni, pg_auto_failover, or a managed service\'s Multi-AZ option)'
segments.zh: '# （Patroni、pg_auto_failover，或託管服務的 Multi-AZ 選項）'

segments.en: 'Postgres writes every change to its write-ahead log (WAL) and streams it to the replicas, which replay it.'
segments.zh: 'Postgres 會把每筆變更寫進預寫式日誌（WAL），並串流給副本重播。'

segments.en: 'Commit as soon as the primary has the write. Fast, and the replicas catch up when they can. This is the lab\'s “Async”.'
segments.zh: '主資料庫一拿到寫入就提交。很快，副本有空時再追上。這就是實驗室的「非同步」。'

segments.en: 'Wait until at least one replica confirms each commit. Slower writes, but a promoted replica has everything. The lab\'s “Sync”.'
segments.zh: '等到至少一個副本確認每次提交。寫入較慢，但被升級的副本擁有一切。這就是實驗室的「同步」。'

segments.en: 'One for the primary, one for replicas. Many ORMs and drivers can route automatically.'
segments.zh: '一個給主資料庫，一個給副本。很多 ORM 和驅動程式能自動路由。'

segments.en: 'Always to the primary. Replicas are read-only.'
segments.zh: '一律送到主資料庫。副本是唯讀的。'

segments.en: 'Reads that can be a bit stale'
'Concert lists, search, venue pages. Moving these to replicas is where the capacity win comes from.'
segments.zh: '演唱會清單、搜尋、場館頁面。把這些移到副本，就是容量提升的來源。'

segments.en: 'For a fan who just changed something, read from the primary (or wait for the replica to catch up). That\'s the fix for the “missing ticket”.'
segments.zh: '對剛修改了東西的歌迷，從主資料庫讀取（或等副本追上）。這就是「票不見了」的修法。'

segments.en: 'Something has to notice the primary is gone and promote a replica in seconds. Doing it by hand is the lab\'s 12-second “Manual” setting, and real people usually take much longer.'
segments.zh: '必須有東西察覺主資料庫不見了，並在幾秒內升級副本。用人手來做，就是實驗室裡 12 秒的「手動」設定，而真人通常要花更久。'

segments.en: 'Fans sometimes edit their profile, reload, and see the old version for a second. Profile pages read from a replica. What\'s the simplest fix?'
segments.zh: '歌迷有時修改個人資料、重新整理後，會看到舊版本一秒鐘。個人資料頁是從副本讀取的。最簡單的修法是什麼？'

segments.en: 'That throws away the read capacity for every page to fix one flow.'
segments.zh: '為了修一個流程，就丟掉所有頁面的讀取容量。'

segments.en: 'Read the profile from the primary for a short time after the fan edits it'
segments.zh: '在歌迷修改後的短時間內，從主資料庫讀取個人資料'

segments.en: 'Read-your-writes routing: only the person who just wrote needs fresh data. Everyone else can read from replicas.'
segments.zh: '「讀取自己的寫入」路由：只有剛寫入的人需要最新資料，其他人都可以從副本讀取。'

segments.en: 'With async replication, lag can be small but never guaranteed zero.'
segments.zh: '非同步複製的延遲可以很小，但永遠無法保證是零。'

segments.en: 'Encore uses async replication with automatic failover. The primary crashes. What can be lost?'
segments.zh: 'Encore 使用非同步複製加自動故障轉移。主資料庫當機了。可能遺失什麼？'

segments.en: 'With async replication, the newest writes may not have reached any replica yet.'
segments.zh: '非同步複製時，最新的寫入可能還沒送到任何副本。'

segments.en: 'Writes from the last moments before the crash that hadn\'t reached the replica'
segments.zh: '當機前最後那段時間、還沒送到副本的寫入'

segments.en: 'Roughly the replication lag\'s worth of writes. Sync replication to at least one replica closes that gap.'
segments.zh: '大約是一段複製延遲的寫入量。對至少一個副本使用同步複製，就能補上這個缺口。'

segments.en: 'The promoted replica has everything except the last, unreplicated writes.'
segments.zh: '被升級的副本擁有一切，除了最後那些還沒複製過去的寫入。'
'為什麼不讓每個副本都同步？'

segments.en: 'Every write waits for the slowest required replica, and a down replica can stall writes'
segments.zh: '每次寫入都要等最慢的那個必要副本，而一個掛掉的副本可能讓寫入卡住'

segments.en: 'That\'s why a common setup is one sync replica for safety plus async replicas for reads.'
segments.zh: '這就是為什麼常見的做法是一個同步副本負責安全，再加幾個非同步副本負責讀取。'

segments.en: 'They can. The cost is on the write side.'
